%1$s sends a backup of all the business data to the chosen cloud. It only touches its folder or its three files: everything else stays out of reach. Backups have no encryption of their own unless it is turned on: that cloud\'s account protects them. Without backups, the data is only on this phone. %1$s has no servers and no access to this information.

%1$s records the internal management of the business. It does not replace official accounting and does not issue tax documents.

On Wi-Fi, usually only the last few minutes are at risk. On mobile data, up to about an hour, unless Back up now is tapped. With no internet, if the phone is lost, everything recorded since the last backup is lost.

Nothing goes out on its own: what is at risk is everything recorded since Save to %1$s was last tapped. If %1$s fails silently and the phone is lost, everything after the last backup that truly uploaded is lost: about 7 days or more. It only comes to light when checking.
